en.title: Egret Migrate 0.4 for multi-screen Egret 5 games
en.body: Import matched Egret 5.1.7 projects, inline button skins, row-major tile layouts and scrollable level maps. Reuse fixed-height list renderers, preserve skinned touch targets and release offscreen text rasters while retaining the display tree.

zh.title: Egret Migrate 0.4 支持多界面白鹭 5 游戏
zh.body: 支持引擎与编译器同为 5.1.7 的工程、按钮内联皮肤、按行网格布局和可滚动选关地图。定高列表复用列表项，带皮肤的控件保留原触摸目标，屏外文字释放栅格资源，同时保留显示树。
